text_block_list.text:
After training, Tokai Teio and I are
preparing to
head back.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oof, I'm tuckered out. I got so into my
training
today, I think I might've pushed
myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I will! I'll take a shower and... huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heya, Prez! Whatcha doin'?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Teio. I was on my way to
inspect the
tracks in preparation for the
next Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Inspect the tracks? At this hour? And
you're all
alone?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let me lend a hand! If it's me and
you,
Prez, we'll finish this up in a
flash. ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the offer... but you say this
just as
you've finished training. Are you
sure you're not
overextending yourself?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm all good, no probs here! Right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't wooorry! I'll be fine! All right, let's
knock
this out!

With Tokai Teio all fired up, her words
prove
true, and they finish the
inspection in no time at
all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I'm done taking all the
measurements!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I applaud you, Teio. Thanks to you, I
predict
things will end a lot earlier than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You can head back to your dorm. I'll
take care of
the rest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You mean there's more to do than

measurements?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to conduct a test run to
get a
reference for timing, but I won't
ask more of you
now. You're clearly
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But... but! Hrngh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know! Wait right there! I'll be right
back!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Sorry for the wait! I've got the
solution
right here!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your signature racewear? Why have you
come
wearing that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Cause I said I'd help you, Prez. And I
don't go
back on my word.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way am I gonna leave you hanging
now,
midway through! That would suck!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Once I have my signature racewear on,
that
means I'm never giving up!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose when I'm wearing this! Watch
me, I'm
gonna run this whole thing right
now!

Tokai Teio clears the track with
remarkable form,
as if instantly cured of
her fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Did you see that, Prez? I told you
I could
do it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That was splendid, Teio! I caught every

pertinacious step.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It appears your words hold truth.
Your
racewear does impart a certain
power to you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right! And you know what
that
means?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter the race, I'm gonna win! Even
if it's
against you, Prez.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... is that so? Well, I say time is of the
essence.
How do you feel about having a
scrimmage
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've had to decline many of your
invitations due
to my busy schedule, but
this time I am able to
extend an
invitation of my own.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a scrimmage?! Well, I'm happy you
asked,
but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry—I think I'll pass this time! I'd rather
wait 'til I
can race you on the big stage.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Man... Now I'm really tired. I'm gonna head back! Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The big stage," huh? Considering your
growth
through training, I'd say there's
some bite behind
your bark.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you keep up your diligent efforts, the
future
will be yours to make. I suppose I
mustn't let my
guard down... haha!

Tokai Teio succeeds in helping out
Symboli
Rudolf. However...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it! Aaagh... What have I
done?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just as Prez finally invited me to a
scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just as Prez finally invited me to a
scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh... that's right! First off is getting to
where Prez
is at!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now I'm pumped up! Let's
make it there
together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I said I wouldn't lose, but I
can't win
without some serious practice
first.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah... I can't wait to run against Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We're gonna surpass Prez
together, Trainer!
